summary: Hipcamp listing is live and instant-bookable (reviews through October 2026). Confirmed fees $44.84-59 (re-dated, service fee figures added). Changed hookups electric 0 (derived from note) -> 50 with water (the one RV 30/50A hookup site); added max rig 34 ft, no dump station, potable water, 29-night max. Note kept verbatim (--AWH).
flags: Price gate (hipcamp): the cheapest RV-allowed site is $44.84 host price but $52.79 with Hipcamp's mandatory service fee ($54.58 a night with tax) - over US$50; no gateway within 40 km (Jacksonville 46 km). AWH's own note suggests firsthand knowledge, though trips record no stay here.

RVs/motorhomes are allowed: Sites #1 (25 ft) and #2 (30 ft) take tent or RV, the hookup site RV only (34 ft); a 27-ft Class A reviewer used the hookup site. A May 2026 reviewer warns 'the gravel drive is pretty steep. Be careful to get a rolling start when exiting the gate' (2WD access per the listing).
The --AWH note calls the sites 'primitive'; one site now has 30/50-amp and water (kept verbatim per instructions).
